title: feat(ui): lazy studio i18n namespace; designer.* and perm.* strings move into it (#25922 slice 1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TW2qPuXi9wW2vYi3QL9EbS)_

Part of #25922

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@object-ui/i18n` 新增懒加载的 `studio` 命名空间（en 常驻、zh 按需拉取、其他语言回落 en），并把 Studio 设计器表里的 `designer.*` / `perm.*` 共 349 个键（两种语言）迁入；app-shell 的 `t()` 先查原表、再查命名空间，调用点不变。
- 为什么改：按 #25922 裁决 6431032267（Q2 = A，6431234244 维持）把设计器文案搬进 i18n 包，这是 (M) 的第 1 片，只搬机制和第一块连续的表。
- 风险与回滚：zh 用户首次打开设计器时这些标签会先显示英文、zh 分片到达后同一挂载自动重渲染为中文；回滚即 revert 本 PR（表行原样回到 app-shell）。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/index.ts`，再看 app-shell `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` 的 `lookupString` 与 `useMetadataLocale`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm run check:i18n-designer-parity && pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace-lazy.test.tsx`。
- 需要你做的：无需操作；剩余切片计划见下文 “Remaining slices”，确认或调整即可。ci.yml 的 parity 步骤本 PR 不动，退役放在最后一片（Tier H）。

## What changes

- **New subpath `@object-ui/i18n/namespaces/studio`** (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{index,en,zh}.ts`, `package.json` export). Same residency shape as `locales/registry.ts`: `en` is a static import (the fallback for every key and language), `zh` is one literal `() => import('./zh.js')`. API: `studioString(key, lang)` (synchronous; while the serving catalogue is in flight it starts the fetch and answers from `en`, never the raw key), `loadStudioCatalogue(lang)` (memoised, a rejected load is not memoised), `isStudioCatalogueLoaded`, `resolveStudioLanguage` (exact tag, then base language, else `en`), the `useStudioCatalogue(lang)` hook (`useSyncExternalStore`, re-renders its caller when a catalogue lands), `STUDIO_NAMESPACE`, `STUDIO_FALLBACK_LANGUAGE`, `STUDIO_LANGUAGE_CODES`, `StudioCatalogue`.
- **First slice of the table:** every `designer.*` and `perm.*` row (349 keys per side; one contiguous run on each side of `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` / `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH`) moves out of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` into the namespace, text unchanged.
- **app-shell facade:** the six `pickTable(locale).strings[key]` reads go through `lookupString(key, locale)` = table first, namespace second, so `t` / `tFormat` / `tOptional` / `translateNodeLabel` / `translateNodeHint` / `translateEnumOption` and every call site stay as they are. The 54 zh-only producer keys are untouched and keep their `tOptional` read. `useMetadataLocale()` now also calls `useStudioCatalogue(locale)`, so every designer component re-renders once `zh` lands.
- **Not in the eager catalogue, not in `all-locales-key-parity`, by construction.** `locales/en.ts` gains no key; the namespace's files live outside `locales/` and are not members of `builtInLocales`, which is what that suite iterates. The `index.ts` docblock and the README say so; the namespace's own parity is `studio-namespace.test.ts`.
- **Console chunking** (`ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`): two priority-84 `advancedChunks` groups, `i18n-ns-studio-en` and `i18n-ns-studio-zh`, so the namespace is not swept into the eager `i18n-runtime` group (whose test matches all of `packages/i18n`).
- **Gates read the namespace homes** (`ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` `collectDesignerKeys`, used by `check-i18n-designer-table-parity.mjs` and `check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`): when the table module imports `@object-ui/i18n/namespaces/studio` (the same edge the runtime follows), the homes' `STUDIO_EN` / `STUDIO_ZH` literals are merged into `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` / `_ZH` by AST. A home that cannot be read throws; a key in both homes throws ("exactly one home"); the dead-keys sweep does not count a home literal as a reader. en-drift reads the homes at the same ref, so the move itself is not drift.
- **README:** the "engine.* carve-out" section is rewritten as "Scope — the Studio designer strings (the `studio` namespace)", citing rulings 6431032267 and 6431234244; two comments that cited the old heading name follow it.
- **Changeset:** root `.changeset/25922-studio-i18n-namespace.md`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.
- ⛔ Untouched: `ui/.github/**`, root `ci.yml` (its `check:i18n-designer-parity` step stays), existing keys of the eager locale packs, `ObjectGrid.tsx`.

## Tests

New:

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace.test.ts` (unit): scoped parity (en ⊆ zh, same `{placeholders}`, zh-only keys only in documented families, non-empty values), no namespace key defined by `locales/en.ts` (with a lit control), language resolution table, resident zh answers zh while `de` / `en-US` answer en, unknown key is `undefined`.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace-lazy.test.tsx` (dom, isolated): before the fetch a zh lookup renders en; the same component re-renders in zh once the chunk lands; `de` renders en and fetches nothing.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AddFieldPopover.studioNamespace-25922.test.tsx`: a real Studio screen (Data pillar "Add field" popover, which mixes both homes) through `useMetadataLocale()` — zh first paint is English (never the key), then the same mount is Chinese; table keys read Chinese throughout; `de` renders English from both homes.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts`: six `collectDesignerKeys()` home cases (merge, no import → no homes, unreadable home throws, duplicate key throws, `source` + `readHome`, sweep ignores home literals).
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts`: the two namespace modules route to `i18n-ns-studio-zh` / `i18n-ns-studio-en`.

**Forced test edits** (the zh rows these suites assert synchronously now arrive in a lazily fetched chunk, so each makes zh resident before its first case with a top-level `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`; no assertion changed):

- `metadata-admin/zh-base-term.i18n-13131.test.ts` — the zh census also reads the namespace's zh rows (otherwise it would silently stop covering 349 keys).
- Preload only, 17 files: `metadata-admin/CelTestRunDialog.i18n-10862.test.tsx`, `metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize.test.tsx`, `inspectors/FieldTypePicker.search-12516.test.tsx`, `inspectors/ObjectDefaultInspector.test.tsx`, `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.draft-locale.test.tsx`, `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.labelTranslation-11782.test.tsx`, `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.typePicker-11793.test.tsx`, `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.valueDomain-7597.test.tsx`, `inspectors/inspectorStrings.hookAction.i18n-10586.test.tsx`, `inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10586.test.tsx`, `inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10696.test.tsx`, `inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10748.test.tsx`, `previews/PermissionPreview.rlsPolicies-11027.test.tsx`, `previews/dataPreviews.i18n-10862-s3.test.tsx`, `previews/field-types.studioSurfaces-11909.test.tsx`, `previews/flowFieldChrome.i18n-10862-s4.test.tsx`, `studio-design/BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts` (all under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/`).
- Comment only: `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.referencesErrorState.test.tsx` (cites the README section's new name).

## Acceptance notes

**Console eager bundle does not grow.** Same tree, console `vite build`, BEFORE = the base `i18n.ts` + `vite.config.ts` restored in place, AFTER = this branch:

| | before | after | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| eager closure, gzip | 2,000,416 B | 1,995,304 B | −5,112 |
| eager closure, raw | 6,817,847 B | 6,796,608 B | −21,239 |
| `i18n` chunk (app-shell table), gzip | 118,144 | 105,711 | −12,433 |
| `i18n-runtime`, gzip | 6,308 | 6,637 | +329 |
| `i18n-ns-studio-en` (new, eager), gzip | — | 6,950 | +6,950 |
| `i18n-ns-studio-zh` (new, **lazy**) | — | 22,332 raw | not in the closure |
| `i18n-locale-en` (the eager en catalogue) | 169,775 raw / 53,322 gz | identical, same hash | 0 |

`locales/en.ts` is 270,655 B before and after. `check-eager-locale-catalogues` and `check-eager-closure-budget` exit 0 on the AFTER dist (aggregate 1948.5 KB of 2431.6 KB).

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after each):

- `studioString`'s en fallback → `return undefined;`: 2 red — `studio-namespace-lazy` "answers from en before the zh catalogue lands", `AddFieldPopover` "zh: English while the catalogue is in flight".
- `resolveStudioLanguage`'s `?? STUDIO_FALLBACK_LANGUAGE` → `?? (lang ?? "")`: 8 red, including both third-locale (`de`) screen cases.

**Gates:** `check:i18n-designer-parity` green (ENGINE_STRINGS 3121 en / 3175 zh, the union unchanged), `check:i18n-drift` green with 0 keys added or removed, `check:i18n-dead-keys` and `check:i18n-keys` green.

**Open questions** (implementation choices, not blockers):

1. The namespace is not registered as i18next resources: its values use the designer's `{token}` syntax, which i18next would interpolate as literal text. A later slice could convert, but that is a text change to every row.
2. `useMetadataLocale()` still collapses to `en-US` / `zh-CN`, so a `zh-TW` viewer reads `zh` (as before this PR).
3. `Clause-②: no` is copied from the claim; the PR adds one subpath export, which is additive.

### Remaining slices (proposal)

Remaining app-shell table ≈ 6,430 lines across both locales (engine.inspector 1,644; engine.studio 1,586; engine.packages/form/edit 802; other engine.* 2,398). Changed lines per slice ≈ 2× table lines, each ≤ ~3,000 and each keeping `check:i18n-designer-parity` green; each slice adds the zh preload to the zh suites it touches.

| Slice | Content | Table lines |
|---|---|---:|
| S2 | `engine.inspector.{pageBlock, action, dataset, flowNode, appNav, widget}` | ~1,141 |
| S3 | rest of `engine.inspector` + `engine.packages` / `form` / `edit` (incl. the zh-only `packages.form.help` keys, still read by `tOptional`) | ~1,305 |
| S4 | `engine.studio.{access, if, data, rules, auto, settings}` + ~450 of other `engine.*` | ~1,344 |
| S5 | rest of `engine.studio` + ~650 of other `engine.*` | ~1,342 |
| S6 | the remaining `engine.*` | ~1,300 |
| S7 (Tier H, needs maintainer approval) | `TYPE_LABELS` / `DOMAIN_LABELS` and the zh side tables (`FLOW_FIELD_ZH` …); delete the app-shell table; retire `check:i18n-designer-parity` and its ci.yml step | — |

## Verification

- 226 test files touched by the move (app-shell designer, i18n, ui scripts): 226 passed / 2,907 tests after the clone-to-customize preload; the first run's one red was that zh case, fixed in `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize.test.tsx`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: both exit 0 (after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n build`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 46 derived commands run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived zero). Also run: ui `check:eager-closure`, `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-keys`, all exit 0 on the AFTER console dist. Head `e355404ca8`; 36 files, +1,792 / −961 (2,753 changed lines, under the 3,000 threshold).
